correlation_hypothesis.identifiability: No unique c: section scale ell and spatial cross spectra are unreported. Constant c refers to equal sections with fixed same variance/spectral shape and no cross-arm covariance. This is a hypothesis, not Williams A4.
correlation_hypothesis.source_check: Williams Appendix A A4 explicitly assumes spatially uncorrelated noise; A3/A8 permit a general covariance calculation, but no constant-c interpolation is supplied.

conclusion: Data favor faster growth than fixed-coefficient independent-section sqrt(L) within conditional regression assumptions, and are compatible with fully correlated alpha1 within its95%interval. They do not establish spatial correlation, its extent, or a numeric c. Central alpha>1 cannot be reproduced by the proposed fixed-section constant-c interpolation. No universal spool-to-field conversion of l follows.
engineering_decisions: Unweighted log-OLS with normalization analytically eliminated; homoscedastic independent log residuals assumed for conditional SE/CI.
Hypothetical equicorrelated same-strength sections, constant c, section length ell and independent arms; not sourced model or implemented physics.
validation_limits: Four empirical author-model drift parameters without reported uncertainty/covariance; p-values/SE conditional.
Geometry of spool placement and cross-arm covariance not published.
Changing spool sets/fiber type, length-dependent environmental strength and empirical drift extraction can confound alpha; no unique cause established.
